requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL reports X-kind underflow mode support
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(X) is true for real calculations with the same type as X exactly on processors that support control of the underflow mode for those calculations, and false otherwise.

pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL-X-true-br: Use x = 1.0 and t = TINY(x) from a variable. Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(x), IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(x), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(x), and RADIX(x)==2. Supported binary subnormal branch calls IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(original), calls IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(GRADUAL=.TRUE.), calls IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(changed_gradual) and asserts changed_gradual is .TRUE.; compute r = t/4.0, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(r), assert IEEE_CLASS(r)==IEEE_POSITIVE_SUBNORMAL, and assert r*4.0==t. Then call IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(GRADUAL=.FALSE.), call IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(changed_abrupt) and assert changed_abrupt is .FALSE.; compute z = t/4.0, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(z), and assert IEEE_CLASS(z)==IEEE_POSITIVE_ZERO. Restore original with IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(original), then call IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(restored) and assert restored equals original. Unsupported branch records a skip.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL-X-false-b: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(2.5). False branch records a skip and performs no IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE or IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE call.
